diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~26% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests.
